title: Eval run · skills eval cases (11 bundles) × 2 arms × 1 rep · 9de1cbdc · 2026-11-17
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg1NmbJpZhtiWQkTir

The first round of the published skills' eval cases through the `skill-evals` runner (card #34764, draft PR #34841). Filed as an `eval-run` record with full scores under the maintainer's ruling on #34764 (comment 6946545946): 「A 进本仓带全分,同场景卡」.

## Environment

- Runner: `@objectstack/scenarios` `skill-evals` on branch `claude/issue-34764-skill-evals-runner`. The turns ran from commit `adf4081a`, and the verdicts below were drawn by `--regrade` at `9de1cbdc`. Between those two commits the turn's argv, working directory and grader are byte-identical (`arms.ts` and `grade.ts` are unchanged, and so are the turn-running lines of `run.ts`). Only the with-skill arm check changed (see Reading 4).
- Skills and cases: the workspace `skills/` at `3bbda33b` (origin/main at the branch point): 11 bundles, 26 eval files, 209 cases. No case was added or edited.
- Driver: `claude -p` from Claude Code 2.1.326, login `oauth_token` (subscription), no API key. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were unset, and every turn was spawned without them. Served model `claude-opus-5-5` on every turn (the login's default; no `--model`). Effort: the CLI default (no `--effort`).
- Each turn ran in a fresh temporary directory with `--setting-sources project`, `--tools Read,Glob,Grep,Skill`, `--allowedTools Skill`, an empty `--mcp-config` with `--strict-mcp-config`, `--no-session-persistence` and `--max-turns 16`. The with-skill arm had the bundle in `.claude/skills/BUNDLE/` without its `evals/` directory. The no-skill arm's directory was empty.
- Cost: the CLI's notional figure. Nothing is billed per token under a subscription login.

## Scope

- 209 cases × 2 arms (with-skill, no-skill) × 1 repetition = 418 turns, 4 at once. All 418 ran. The command exited 0, and the regrade exited 0.
- Pass means every `must_contain` token is in the answer (the result line's text) and no `must_not_contain` token is. Tokens match as literal, case-sensitive substrings. No model judged an answer.
- Not measured: none. 0 turns were `invalid`, 0 were `error` and 0 were not run.
- Wall time 56.1 min. Median turn: 30 s with the skill, 24 s without. Notional cost 71.24 USD: 49.13 for the with-skill arm and 22.11 for the no-skill arm. The login's seven-day utilization went from 0.45 to 0.56. The runner stops at 0.9.

## Reading

One repetition, so each case's score is a single draw. Per-bundle rates on 5 to 12 cases can move by a case or two on a re-run. This is the first record of this kind, so there is no earlier record to compare with.

1. With the bundle installed, 144/209 answers (69%) carry their case's tokens. Without it, 20/209 (10%) do. Every bundle scores higher with its skill than without, from objectstack-upgrade at 2/5 vs 0/5 to objectstack-formula at 10/12 vs 1/12.
2. 65 cases fail on the with-skill arm, and these are what the skills are iterated from. In 63 of them the no-skill arm fails too. In 2 the no-skill arm passes while the with-skill arm carries a forbidden token: `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#16`, `objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#2`.
3. 18 cases pass on both arms. On this login's model they do not tell the skill apart from the model's own knowledge.
4. `objectui` sets `user-invocable: false` in its `SKILL.md`, and Claude Code 2.1.326 leaves such a skill out of the init line's `skills` list, although the model can still launch it. The run as recorded therefore marked all 34 `objectui` with-skill turns `invalid` (the runner's arm check, not the model). The runner was fixed to grade them and name the evidence, and `--regrade` re-drew those 34 verdicts from their recorded answers. 33 of the 34 turns launched `objectui`, and in 1 nothing in the stream shows the skill (`objectui/app-composition#2`, which passed). The other 175 with-skill turns show their bundle on the init line.
5. 144 permission denials across 111 turns: a tool the turn was given was refused a call it needed a permission for, such as a read outside the turn's directory. This round's records keep only the count. The runner now also records which tool was refused, from the next round on.

## Findings filed from this run

- none. The 65 with-skill failing cases are listed above for `domain:skills` to route. The charter line that routes them is the eval seat's own PR, which follows the runner's.
